description: This file declares an interface for high-resolution time management functions, including retrieving the current time, calculating future times, measuring elapsed time, comparing times, converting times to string format, and converting to timespec structure.

methods.name: rtTime_Now
methods.description: Gets the current system time and stores it in the provided rtTime_t structure.

methods.name: rtTime_Later
methods.description: Calculates a time that is a specified number of milliseconds after a given time or now if the input is NULL.

methods.name: rtTime_Elapsed
methods.description: Computes the number of milliseconds elapsed between two times, defaulting to current time if end is NULL.

methods.name: rtTime_Compare
methods.description: Compares two times and returns -1, 0, or 1 depending on their order.

methods.name: rtTime_ToString
methods.description: Converts a rtTime_t into a human-readable string format HH:MM:SS.mmm.

methods.name: rtTime_ToTimespec
methods.description: Converts a rtTime_t into a timespec structure suitable for certain system calls.
